text: Use discomfort as a signal LED. In the lives of many people there is so much discomfort and at the same time prohibition against changing something that they prefer to stop feeling their body. But you are developing, which means for you discomfort is an honest adviser pointing to the fact that something is going wrong. Even obviously, at the level of the body—an uncomfortable pose, tension in some areas—these are signals pointing to the need for change, not endurance. To ignore them means to betray your nature and go into illness, that is, subconsciously choose death, not life. But your goal is Life!
